sentences.text:
Counsel for Revisionist :- Qazi Vakil Ahmad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Girish Singh Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard Mr. Qazi Vakil Ahmad, learned counsel for the revisionists, learned Additional Government Advocate representing the State and Mr. Girish Singh, learned counsel for opposite party no. 2.

The instant criminal revision under Section 397/401 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed against the bailable warrant dated 28.03.2024 and order dated 15.02.2024 passed by Additional District and Sessions Judge, Court No. 13/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Kanpur Dehat in Special Session Trial No. 225 of 2019 (State Vs. Suraj @ Boby and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 0773 of 2019, under Sections 363, 366, 376(3), 120B IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, 2012,
police station Ghatampur, district Kanpur Nagar whereby the Trial Court in exercise of powers Ghanshyam Singh And 6 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193960546/
1 under Section 319 Cr.P.C. has summoned the revisionists as an additional accused to face trial in the above case on the basis of statements of PW-1 Ramchandra, PW-2 victim-A and PW-3 Kamlesh Kumari recorded before the trial Court.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Court No. 13/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Kanpur Dehat
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Ghanshyam Singh And 6 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionists after advancing his arguments at some length and putting certain query by this Court in the light of judgement of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Hardeep Singh Vs. State of Punjab and others, (2014) 3 SCC 92 gave up his challenge to the aforesaid impugned bailable warrant and summoning order under Section 319 Cr.P.C. against the revisionists and confined his submission requesting to grant some protection to the revisionists to surrender before the concerned Court below.

entities.text: Hardeep Singh Vs. State of Punjab and others, (2014) 3 SCC 92
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionists further stated at the Bar that he is not pressing any other prayer made by means of this Criminal Revision on merits and prayed that a direction may be issued to the concerned Court below to decide the bail application of the revisionists expeditiously.

Learned A.G.A. for the State of U.P. and learned counsel for complainant submit that in case the revisionists are not pressing the relief as sought for by them on merits and want to surrender before the concerned Court below, they have no objection if the Court grants protection to them for a short period.
In view of the above, the relief as sought by the revisionists in the instant Criminal Revision is refused.

However, considering the aforesaid alternative prayer made by learned counsel for the revisionists,
it is directed that if the revisionists surrender/appear before the concerned Court below within three weeks from today and apply for bail, the bail application of the revisionists shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously by the concerned court below in accordance with law and keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For the period of three weeks from today or till the time of surrender of the revisionists before the concerned Court below, whichever is earlier, they shall not be arrested in the above case.

With the above observations and directions, this Criminal Revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C.
stands disposed of.
